{{Quote|My daughter has become something of a liability to me. I want you to kill her.|Admiral Fraabaal, speaking to a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]]|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Fraabaal''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] serving in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|navy]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I'm afraid many of our Imperial soldiers are hopeless with delicate tasks. This, of course, is why I asked for a professional.|Admiral Fraabaal, speaking to the Hunter|audio=AskedForProfessional-Fraabaal-TOR.flac|<ref name="TOR" />}}
His daughter [[Vereta Fraabaal]] was a [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] to [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Grathan]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. After Grathan went rogue and Vereta followed him, Fraabaal hired a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] to kill his daughter, rather than face the political consequences of her involvement.<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameDS}}
After the hunter brought word to Fraabaal that his daughter was dead, he expressed disgust and asked the hunter to leave immediately.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
If the hunter chooses to spare Vereta by freezing her in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] and taking her to her father, Fraabaal will express dismay at first, but then thank the hunter, revealing that he had felt regret over attempting to have his daughter killed.<ref name="TOR" />

==Appearances==
